races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: WUNDERSCHON took another step forward in a Leopardstown Group 3 recently and looks the one to beat back in a maiden. San Juan de Lope is an appealing newcomer, while Petticoat Bay and Itstheonlyoneigot should improve on the back of promising debut runs. WUNDERSCHON (GER) SAN JUAN DE LOPE (IRE) PETTICOAT BAY (USA)

races.display_title: Racing In The City Of Tribes Handicap
races.verdict: A chance is taken on EARLS who has dropped to 8 lb lower than when third in a stronger race here at the summer festival. Jp's Express is respected on the back of his good third in a big field at the Curragh recently. San Aer 's fine Galway record, including 2 wins in this race, earns him a place on the shortlist along with Johnny Murtagh's Flash of Fire . EARLS (IRE) JP'S EXPRESS (IRE) SAN AER (IRE)

races.display_title: Galway Handicap
races.verdict: BEN HUR has been in good heart in his 3 outings this season, making his second handicap start on the Flat a winning one at Leopardstown in August and runner-up in a listed handicap over hurdles since. He gets the vote ahead of the hat-trick seeking Ryefield Dasher , with Granville Street also considered. BEN HUR (IRE) RYEFIELD DASHER (IRE) GRANVILLE STREET (IRE)

races.display_title: Celebrating Helen MacKinnon's LX Years Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: MY MATE MACKLEY has yet to finish out the frame in handicaps and proved game when adding to his tally at Brighton 3 weeks ago. He looks a big player on the back of a 3 lb rise in his pursuit of the hat-trick. Knicks faces his easiest assignment for a long time and ought to play a lead role from a career-low mark, with Eldeyaar and Ski Angel next best. MY MATE MACKLEY KNICKS (IRE) ELDEYAAR (IRE)

races.display_title: Remembering Kevin Lumb AKA Burnley Kevin Handicap
races.verdict: A facile winner at Chester in September, MIRACULOUS will find this less demanding than recent assignments and with the step back up in trip another likely plus, he could well be the way to go. Yarmouth scorer Marching Mac thrives in testing conditions and is feared, with the selection's stablemate Manila Scouse another to consider. MIRACULOUS (IRE) MARCHING MAC (IRE) MANILA SCOUSE

races.verdict: HAVANA RUM shaped quite well when belatedly tackling 7f for the first time at Newcastle recently and is worth a chance to confirm that promise. Last year's winner Evocative Spark heads the many possible dangers along with Tim Easterby's pair Vince Le Prince and Mister Sox , both of whom know where the winning post is here. HAVANA RUM (IRE) EVOCATIVE SPARK (IRE) VINCE LE PRINCE

races.display_title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: Marginal preference is for BESSIE WALLIS who got right back on track when just denied at Brighton last time and is fancied to go one better off the same mark here. Hvar has failed to hit top form for John and Sean Quinn but can boast winning C&D form and is not ruled out with Oisin Murphy an eye-catching booking.
